gemini.depth_why: Scores reflect the cold climate, with only a brief summer period reaching marginal levels.
gemini.overview: St Andrews and the Fife coast offer wide, sandy beaches like West Sands and Elie, but the Scottish climate keeps things cool. Even at the height of summer, lying out on the sand is a brisk experience, often requiring a windbreak and a sweater rather than a swimsuit. The long daylight hours provide plenty of time outside, though true heat is rare.

blurbs.text: Highs stay in the 40s and low 50s. The beaches are empty of anyone lying out, as the cold wind and frequent rain make the shores a place for brisk walks rather than lingering.
Afternoon highs reach the upper 50s. The days are long and often bright, but the air remains too chilly to comfortably lie on the sand.

Highs in the 60s mark the warmest part of the year. On the brightest, calmest days, locals set up windbreaks on West Sands or the sheltered coves of the East Neuk to catch the sun, though the air stays cool and rain is common.
Temperatures drop back into the 40s and 50s, and the days grow short and gray. The shores are too cold and damp to sit out.

gemini.depth_why: Scores follow the transition between the wet summer and the dry, sunny winter.
gemini.overview: The main draw for lying in the sun here is the collection of safari lodges and resort pools scattered around the falls and national park. Visitors can relax on loungers between game drives, enjoying reliably hot weather. The dry season from May to October brings the clearest skies and most comfortable heat.

blurbs.text: Heavy summer rains bring frequent downpours and high humidity. The sun still shines between storms, and highs in the mid-80s keep the lodge pools warm.
The rains taper off, leaving clear skies. Afternoon highs in the low to mid-80s make for comfortable afternoons on a lounger.
Dry, sunny days dominate, with almost no rain for months at a time. Highs range from the mid-70s in mid-winter to the 90s by October, providing ideal heat for relaxing by the water.
The wet season returns, bringing increasing clouds and regular rain showers. Highs push into the upper 80s, making the pools a welcome relief when the sun breaks through.
